pattern: echo "=== symlink targets целы? ===" printf '%s -> ' "$f" readlink -f "$f" 2>/dev/null echo echo "=== dotfiles copyq module ===" ls -la ~/dotfiles/copyq/.config/copyq/ 2>/dev/null echo echo "=== copyq.conf (dotfiles) ===" sed -n '1,200p' ~/dotfiles/copyq/.config/copyq/copyq.conf 2>/dev/null grep -viE 'password|secret|token' grep -iE 'maxitems|check|ignore|_items|log|clipboard|history|encrypt|tab' echo "(нет релевантных строк / файл пуст)" echo echo "=== фильтры copyq-filter.ini ===" cat ~/dotfiles/copyq/.config/copyq/copyq-filter.ini 2>/dev/null head -40 echo echo "=== ~/.local/share/copyq tree (свежие сверху) ===" find ~/.local/share/copyq -maxdepth 3 -printf '%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM %s %p\n' 2>/dev/null sort -r head -40
